text:
maria: Quick sync — dry run for the cloud marketplace launch tomorrow 9:00am PT. final checklist pls.
chris: On it. marketing has the blog draft ready, just waiting on a final hero image and embargo window.
elaine: Localization note — we need strings in FR/DE/JP by EOD today to hit translations for tomorrow.
sophie: SI partners asked for the integration guide link and a cut of the sample tenant config. i posted a stub in Confluence but can push today. @maria can you confirm which partners get early access?
maria: @sophie — early access list = Nimbus Cloud, VertexWorks, and HarborSI. i'll DM legal list for contracts.
tony: Legal signoff: we need partner quotes and logo use approvals by 5pm. also embargo agreement signed or we hold quote.
chris: Embargo window proposal: embargo lift Tue 15:00 UTC. press list: TechCrunch, VentureBeat, The Register + partner channels. agree? :eyes:
elaine: Works for EU timelines. i need the blog strings asap — i'll take the markdown and return localized versions by 17:30 PT if i have the base.
maria: Action items (short):
- marketing: finalize hero + blog markdown (chris)
- legal: logo & quote signoffs (tony)
- loc: FR/DE/JP strings (elaine)
- SI: publish integration guide + sample tenant (sophie)
- partnerships: confirm partner assets + co-announcement bullets (maria)
chris: uploading hero assets now -> https://redwood-assets.s3/marketplace/hero_v3.png
chris: blog draft link: https://docs.redwood/inbox/marketplace-blog-draft.md
tony: i've got one pending quote from Nimbus PR. pinging their comms lead now. :white_check_mark:
sophie: Integration guide link: https://confluence.redwood/sis/integration-guide-draft (wip). sample config: ```tenant:
  name: partner-nimbus
  region: us-west-2
  model: rdx-llama-4b```
elaine: small question on copy: do we use "Redwood Dedicated" or just "Redwood" in localized copy for partner pages? that affects translation length.
maria: use "Redwood Dedicated" only where product differentiation is required; otherwise plain "Redwood". keep copy shorter for JP.
chris: timeline reminder: we need final approved blog + landing by 14:00 PT tomorrow to run the embargo on schedule. any blockers?
tony: blocker: one partner legal still needs a CNAME approval for partner landing. i'll escalate now.
eliane: (typo) — elaine: confirming i can compress the JP strings if needed, will advise if anything overflows.
maria: ok — last call: can everyone react with :thumbsup: if you can hit your items by EOD? we'll do a final 8:30am PT stand tomorrow to run through the dry run.
chris: :thumbsup:
tony: :thumbsup:
elaine: :thumbsup:
sophie: :thumbsup:
maria: thanks team — i will post the dry-run agenda in #partnerships in 30m. deploy-bot: reminder for tomorrow's scheduled dry-run channel thread.
deploy-bot: scheduled reminder posted for 2024-03-22 16:00 UTC (dry-run)
maria: I'll also attach the co-announcement bullets once Nimbus confirms their quote. short and partner-forward.
chris: i'll queue the partner social assets and PR distribution lists after legal clears logos.
sophie: will update the integration guide with final tenant example and version tag v0.9 before EOD.
elaine: sending localization kickoff note in 10m.
maria: perfect — see you all at 8:30am PT tomorrow. :rocket:
